ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached image there is a 3×3 grid. The cells at the four corners are all B; the cells in the middle of the four sides are all A; the very center cell is N. The problem requires reading BANANA; each step can only move to an adjacent cell that shares one side with the current cell, and cells may be reused. Reasoning: Reading BANANA requires passing through B-A-N-A-N-A in order. The starting B can be any one corner, for a total of 4 choices. Each corner B is adjacent to only two side-middle A cells, so there are 2 choices for the second letter A. Starting from any such A, the only adjacent N is the center cell, so there is 1 way to get to N. Starting from the center N, there are four adjacent A cells, up, down, left, and right, for a total of 4 choices. Then from any A returning to N, there is still only the center N, so 1 choice. Finally, from the center N to the last A, there are again 4 choices. Therefore the total number is 4 × 2 × 1 × 4 × 1 × 4 = 128.

method.method_draft: Use a symmetry-based step count. First read the image as a 3×3 grid with B in all four corners, A in the four edge-center cells, and N in the center. From the text, the target word is BANANA, moves must be only across shared edges, and cells may be reused. Count choices letter by letter: choose the starting B corner in 4 ways; from any corner B there are exactly 2 adjacent A cells; from any such A the only adjacent N is the center, so 1 way; from the center N there are 4 adjacent A cells; from any A again the only adjacent N is the center, so 1 way; finally from the center N there are 4 adjacent A cells. Multiply the independent choices: 4·2·1·4·1·4 = 128.

推理：读 BANANA 需要按顺序经过 B-A-N-A-N-A。起始 B 可以选任意一个角，共 4 种。每个角上的 B 只与两个边中间的 A 相邻，所以第二个字母 A 有 2 种选择。从任意这样的 A 出发，唯一相邻的 N 是中心格，所以到 N 有 1 种。从中心 N 出发，相邻的 A 有上下左右四个，共 4 种。再从任意 A 回到 N，仍只有中心 N，故 1 种。最后从中心 N 到最后一个 A，又有 4 种选择。因此总数为 4 × 2 × 1 × 4 × 1 × 4 = 128。
